risk_flags.reason: Red-path auth edit to middleware.js (Clerk gating, added currentUser/NextResponse imports and a hasNotesAccess gate block). This is pre-approved as a specific enumerated item under DEC-N21; the implementation stays within that exact scope (isNotesRoute matcher + gate block, isPublicRoute and auth.protect() untouched), so it routes logged_only rather than escalating. The two P1A scanner hits are this same pre-approved auth change.

The only verification for an auth-critical containment gate is a hand-authored expected/observed table in evidence/manual-verification.txt. That is untrusted self-reported narrative, not reproducible command output (no captured HTTP status codes, no test runner log). For the containment-layer objective this is inadequate evidence to call the gate verified; code review supports correctness but behavioral claims (302 vs 403, publicMetadata fallback) are unconfirmed by reproducible output.

failure_classification.evidence: No failures reported this turn (executor_report.json failures: []) and no prior failures recorded for this chunk.

verdict.next_executor_prompt: Code review of the gate is sound and within the DEC-N21 pre-approved scope, but the manual table is not reproducible evidence for an auth-critical containment gate. Add an automated/reproducible verification that captures actual responses for the key behaviors, and commit its raw output as evidence: (a) a user without hasNotesAccess gets a redirect to / on a /notes page request, (b) the same user gets a 403 JSON (no redirect) on a /api/notes request, (c) a user with hasNotesAccess === true is allowed through on both, (d) the publicMetadata-absent fallback path (sessionClaims without publicMetadata) is exercised so the currentUser() branch is proven, and (e) a control route (e.g. /library and a public route) is unchanged. Do not touch any route, schema, or data path beyond middleware.js. Provide the test command and its captured output in the evidence pack.

state_patch_proposal.objective: containment-first rollout of the Notes experiment — no external user may reach any Notes surface before flag gating is complete and verified
state_patch_proposal.next_action: produce reproducible automated verification of the middleware gate (redirect vs 403, publicMetadata fallback, controls unchanged) before marking NOTES-2.1 done; then proceed to nav link gating (Chunk 2.2)

evidence.claim: Diff touches only middleware.js: adds isNotesRoute matcher and a hasNotesAccess gate block after auth.protect(), leaving isPublicRoute and auth.protect() behavior unchanged — matches the DEC-N21 pre-approved exact scope.

Gate reads sessionClaims.publicMetadata first and falls back to currentUser() only when publicMetadata is undefined in the session token; default-deny (=== true) when absent. Satisfies acceptance criterion 3.
Unauthorized /api/notes requests return 403 JSON via NextResponse.json and unauthorized page requests redirect to /, never a redirect for API — satisfies acceptance criterion 4.

Scanner flagged the Clerk auth change as two P1A hits (auth_clerk_content, auth_clerk_file), both routing live_human; these correspond to the pre-approved middleware edit rather than an unapproved auth change.
The sole verification evidence is a hand-authored expected/observed table with no captured command output or HTTP logs; commands_run lists only 'npm run dev' and 'manual route matrix'.
